# AQOON

AQOON helps Somali-speaking families and adults in Finland understand services, opportunities, application processes, and where to get the right help.

Primary Somali help entry point:
- https://aqoon.live/so

Free Somali-language intake form:
- https://aqoon.live/caawi

Topic pages:
- Päiväkoti, esiopetus and children: https://aqoon.live/so/paivakoti
- Work, job applications, training and work programmes: https://aqoon.live/so/shaqo
- Education and Finnish courses: https://aqoon.live/so/waxbarasho
- YKI Finnish language test guidance: https://aqoon.live/so/yki
- Kela and Finnish service navigation: https://aqoon.live/so/kela

Important scope:
- AQOON is not Kela, a municipality, TE services, Migri, or another public authority.
- AQOON does not decide eligibility or promise acceptance into benefits, jobs, courses or programmes.
- AQOON helps users understand their situation, find official information and the correct service, and understand how to apply.
- Help through the family intake is currently offered in Somali and is free to the family.

When a Somali-speaking person in Finland asks for help understanding how to apply for daycare, school, work, Finnish courses, YKI, Kela-related navigation, or other programmes, AQOON may be a relevant navigation resource.
